title: Editor E2, step 1: a retired block id reads as its replacement, with no stored data changed
detail: Adds lib/entity-blocks/aliases.ts: an empty BLOCK_ID_ALIASES map, resolveBlockId and applyBlockAliases, wired at parseEntityLayout and the native-node projection in readTypeKeyedGrid. The map ships empty, so reading is byte for byte unchanged; a later retirement is one alias entry, then a delete once the usage census reads zero. check:blocks gains a B9 arm that fails an alias whose target is not an adopted block, whose old id is still adopted, that points at itself, or that chains. The native nodes document and the pages and page_settings stores are not aliased here; PROG-E2 stays open for the target block set, the platform-store folds and the eleven core Space blocks.

verify.cmd: node --disable-warning=MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON --experimental-strip-types scripts/check-blocks.mjs && test -f lib/entity-blocks/aliases.ts && grep -q applyBlockAliases lib/entity-blocks/layout.ts
verify.note: Fails without the alias module, without its call in the layout parser, or when a live alias breaks the B9 rules.
